snippet.title: Bound By A Curse | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Bound By A Curse is a two-player asymmetric horror game where one player explores a dangerous environment while the other guides them from a control room. A curse causes you to swap positions throughout the game at random times, letting you experience both roles and creating chaotic moments.

Wishlist Bound By A Curse here:
